text.title: Conversion Tracking Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable conversion-tracking signals to a rule from 01-core-rules.xml. Every leaf references a rule id.

decision-tree.root-question: Does the site send conversion events to at least one analytics or advertising destination (GA4, Google Ads, Meta, Plausible)?

conclusion.verdict: nothing to track into; pick an analytics setup methodology first

branch.question: Is every event name in the tracking calls present in `events.yml` with its required parameters, and does CI run `validate-events.py`?

conclusion.verdict: register every event and its conversion role; wire the validator into CI before any other change

branch.question: Which tracking signal fails on inspection of the config, the tag code and the QA record?

conclusion.verdict: push Consent Mode v2 defaults before the config call; mirror consent server-side
rename to snake_case within limits; use the recommended event name
add value, currency and a per-order transaction_id shared across destinations

branch.when: dual_send == true AND (shared_event_id == false OR browser_ids_forwarded == false)

conclusion.verdict: share event id; forward _fbp/_fbc and the _ga client_id plus session_id
strip identifying query params; hash matching identifiers with SHA-256
move the server container to a first-party subdomain
run fixtures in Chrome, Safari, Firefox plus an ad-blocker profile; record results
emit the config artefact; surface ready_for_review=true

text.example: destinations=2 -> unregistered_events=0, ci_validation=true -> consent_defaults_before_config=true, transaction_id_present=true, shared_event_id=true, pii_in_payload=false, server_endpoint_first_party=true, qa_browsers=3 -> conclusion ref=run-the-checklist
